texts: Iron Man, Tony Stark, died in Spider-Man: Far From Home, after he had sacrificed himself to defeat Thanos and save the world in Avengers: Endgame.

In the climactic battle of the fictional Spider-Man film, Iron Man sacrifices himself to save New York City from the villainous scheme unleashed by Mysterio. As Spider-Man finds himself ensnared in Mysterio's illusions, Iron Man utilizes his advanced technology to break through and disable the illusory drones. In a poignant moment, Iron Man uses a risky maneuver that requires an overload of his arc reactor, which he knows will lead to his demise. The film reaches its emotional peak as Tony Stark shares a heartfelt exchange with Peter Parker, urging him to continue fighting for justice. The scene marks a pivotal moment for Spider-Man, as he must carry forward the legacy left by his fallen mentor.

Iron Man (Tony Stark) dies in Avengers: Endgame, not in Spider-Man. However, his death is referenced in Spider-Man: Far From Home, which takes place after the events of Avengers: Endgame.

In Spider-Man: Far From Home, it is mentioned that Tony Stark sacrificed himself to save the world from Thanos and his army in Avengers: Endgame.

Iron Man is not dead in Spider-Man, which is the Marvel Comics character that first introduced him as part of the Peter Parker storyline. The story arc where Iron Man first appeared was in the comic book series "Spider-Man" by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby. In this arc, Iron Man is initially portrayed as an old man with a beard and a black suit, but he transforms into a young boy after his father is killed by the villain Electro.
After that incident, Iron Man becomes a hero again when he defeats Electro and saves the city from the evil organization The Syndicate. He then gains superhuman abilities and uses them to protect the city and save countless lives throughout the comics' run.
So while Iron Man is often depicted as an older man or a man who has been through various transformations, he never actually dies in the comics. His final appearance was in "The Amazing Spider-Man" arc where he became a superhero and saved the world from the evil entity Mysterio.
